name: Layer Cake
summary: A bakery stacking game: drop sliding cake layers, slice the overhang and build the tallest cake
about: A full bakery page where cake layers glide in from the side and you drop each one onto the stack. Whatever hangs over is sliced off and tumbles onto the table with crumbs, while a cheeky piping bag follows the layer, squeezes on every drop and gets heart eyes for a perfect one. Good as a fun corner for a bakery, a birthday page or any playful site.
how: A demo plays on load; press Play, Space or tap the cake to start your own game.
Press Space, Enter or tap to drop the sliding layer; the part that misses the cake is sliced off.
A perfect drop scores more, and three perfect drops in a row make the layer grow back wider.
Each level is an order of layers; finishing it gives a bonus and the layers slide faster and start to wobble.
P or Escape pauses, R restarts, and your best score and tallest cake are kept and marked on the wall ruler.
With reduced motion the stack does not sway or squash and there are fewer crumbs and sprinkles.
